subject.title: feat(gateway): enable the operator terminal by default

question: Should upgrades with no existing `gateway.terminal.enabled` setting begin exposing the Gateway host terminal and its WASM CSP relaxation to `operator.admin` users by default?
rationale: The patch intentionally broadens a host-shell and browser-policy boundary for existing configurations; source consistency cannot determine whether that security and upgrade tradeoff matches maintainer policy.

options.title: Protect existing upgrades
options.body: Keep the current opt-in behavior for existing deployments through an explicit migration or setup-state policy, while allowing fresh installations to choose the new default.

options.title: Accept default-on exposure
options.body: Approve the documented behavior that absent configuration means admin operators receive host-terminal access after upgrade, with the existing `false` opt-out.

recommendation.title: Protect existing upgrades
recommendation.body: Keep the current opt-in behavior for existing deployments through an explicit migration or setup-state policy, while allowing fresh installations to choose the new default.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR description attributes the policy decision to the author and the author owns the proposed implementation boundary.
